source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: يوم من أيام الشتا، نزلت شتا قوية من الصبح.
sentences.en: One winter day, heavy rain fell from the morning.

sentences.ar: كنت لازم أروح عالشغل بس الطريق كان مليان مي.
sentences.en: I had to go to work but the road was full of water.
I put on a coat, carried an umbrella, and went out.
The wind was strong and flipped the umbrella.

sentences.ar: انبليت كلي بس ضحكت على حالي.
sentences.en: I got completely soaked but laughed at myself.

sentences.ar: لما وصلت الشغل، زملائي جابولي منشفة وشاي سخن.
sentences.en: When I got to work, my colleagues brought me a towel and hot tea.
We sat talking about the rain and laughing.

sentences.ar: آخر النهار، وقفت الشتا وطلعت الشمس.
sentences.en: At the end of the day, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
I went home and the world was clear and beautiful.
